standard: shampoo-classification-v1.6.1 candidate (lane-a scrubbed copy); not a locked policy id

formulaBlock.normalization: ID-2: 'Water/Aqua/Eau' one entry; no split entries; 22 normalized entries; normalized positions

cleansingStrength.rationale: low by C6: no strong anionic anywhere; the earliest prominent cleansing surfactant is the amphoteric Cocamidopropyl Betaine @2, followed by nonionic Coco-Glucoside @3 and mild anionics Sodium Lauroyl Sarcosinate @4 and Disodium 2-Sulfolaurate @5 (C3b mild anionic; not the earliest, so the C3b sulfolaurate confidence cap does not apply). Any order among these still yields C6 low (mild anionic plus amphoteric/glucoside co-surfactant). Counter-signal recorded: two mild anionic routes.

conditioningLevel.rationale: moderate: one meaningful conditioning system, the prominent cationic polymer Polyquaternium-47 @11, with light routes PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @10 (weak refatter), Panthenol @13, Glycerin @15. No silicone, no payload lipid, no pearlizing route, so C2 is not met and high is not available. Counter-signal: Polyquaternium-47 sits after Piroctone Olamine @9 (a capped active) and is plausibly a small amount; low is the realistic neighbor.

wLineRecord.note: Piroctone Olamine @9: (i) cleansing surfactants @2-5 before it; (ii) no cleansing surfactant, alkanolamide or pearlizing wax between @10 and @18. No payload_lipid in the formula, so the W-line gates nothing here.

weightPotential.counterevidence: Two deposition families (a cationic polymer and a weak refatter) are present, and the mild C6 chassis offers little reset.
weightPotential.whyThisBand: The only depositing system is one light cationic polymer listed after the W-line (after the capped active Piroctone Olamine), plus a weak refatter and humectants; no silicone, no payload lipid, no film former.
weightPotential.whyNotNeighborBand: W2: the two families are one light polymer listed after a capped (about 1 % or less) active and a weak_refatter; with no silicone or lipid the combined residue is plausibly below noticeable even with mild reset. moderate stays the realistic neighbor because reset is weak.
weightPotential.confidenceLimitingFactor: amount of Polyquaternium-47 unknown; weak reset
weightPotential.rationale: low: light, low-persistence deposition (one late cationic polymer plus weak refatter), W2 reason named (6.6, W2).

careDirection.limitation: formula-only; light humectant cluster without deposition support

focusPrimary.counterSignal: Recognized dandruff active Piroctone Olamine @9 makes scalp_active the formula-compatible candidate if a dandruff claim appears.
focusPrimary.decisionTrace: Blind pass: claim direction null; formula compatible with scalp_active (dandruff active present) but focus needs exact-product positioning; provisional general.
focusPrimary.rationale: provisional general (formula-only); scalp_active is the neighbor pending claims (7.2).

focusSecondary.decisionTrace: Empty default considered; no claims visible.

usageRole.rationale: provisional regular: dandruffSupport supported, so treatment fires if a qualifying E2 dandruff claim graded moderate/high appears (U3); frequent possible (cleansing low) with U2 wording.

scalpComfortTarget.rationale: provisional not_targeted: no positioning visible (SC1). Formula half CSA is met: prominent E4 comfort route Panthenol @13 and humectant/refatting routes PEG-7 Glyceryl Cocoate @10, Glycerin @15; mild C6 chassis is supportive; fragrance @19 and citrus peel oil @20 not prominent.

dandruffSupport.rationale: supported: Piroctone Olamine @9 in a complete formula (Section 11). Whether a dandruff target is projected depends on a dandruff claim (S-DANDRUFF, R17.3).

surfactantClasses.c4: no defining anionic; C6 earliest prominent = Cocamidopropyl Betaine @2

uncertainties: conditioningLevel moderate vs low: one light cationic polymer after a capped active; recorded moderate with low as neighbor.
weightPotential low vs moderate: two families present (W2 reason named); reset weak.
